response: Use @purista/hono-http-server (HonoServiceClass) to project builder-declared commands. Use @purista/amqpbridge with AmqpBridge as the event transport. Keep that event bridge separate from @purista/redis-queue-bridge and RedisQueueBridge, where a queue worker performs the invoice work with strict idempotency. Resolve credentials using @purista/aws-secret-store and AWSSecretStore; never place them in the handler or telemetry.
